_comment: FX catalog — every named effect the game can play. Each record picks one built-in visual (`visual`, or 'none' for sound-only), tunes it (`params`, only values that differ from the visual's defaults), and names the sounds played at the start (`cast_sfx`) and on impact (`hit_sfx`). Spells, items, effects, abilities and monster abilities point at a record by `fx_id`. Edited in the editor's FX page. See docs/data_dictionary/fx.md.
